_meta.source: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census, table 98-10-0002-01 (population by census subdivision). Centre points are approximate locations of each municipality's main shopping area, placed by hand.
_meta.use: Out-of-town shopping destinations for Niagara Falls residents, and the homes of shoppers who drive into Niagara Falls. Each town pulls in proportion to its population relative to Niagara Falls (94,415).
_meta.seeds: detour_factor and highway_kmh convert straight-line distance beyond the city's edge into road distance and time. in_town_kmh is the speed of a local trip inside a town. Town residents are assumed to spend like the average Niagara Falls household and to have grown in step with the city.
